result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 2 (Government), covering city design-build public works procurement (Divisions 33 and 34), retrieved from a page whose URL suggests an algorithmic rent-price-fixing prohibition but whose text does not contain that content.
result.notes: No rules in scope. This part contains only San Diego Municipal Code sections 22.3303-22.3403 on design-build public works procurement (selection methods, prequalification, task orders, progressive design-build authority, definitions). None concern rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. Despite the source URL referencing a prohibition on algorithmic rent price fixing (a San Diego zoning-code division), no text of that ordinance appears in this part, so nothing can be extracted.
